release_notes:
1. Product Catalog Strategy In-Context Guidelines: Added detailed descriptions under the Back Office setting explaining exactly when to use Composite ID, Base Product ID, or Reference/SKU.
2. Enhanced Back Office UX: Visual tip badges and use-case recommendations for Google Merchant Center, Meta Catalog, and TikTok Ads.
3. Automatic Fallbacks: Seamless fallback to database composite ID if an SKU is missing on a product.
